title: The House Concept: How to Build Your Finances

scenes.voice: Most people build their finances like a house with no foundation. Then one bad wind takes everything.
scenes.text: Is your money built on legs?
scenes.visual: A house with no stilts tipping over in a strong wind, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Think of your finances like building a house on stilts. You don't start from the roof. You start from the legs.
scenes.visual: Empty plot of land with a dotted outline of a stilt house, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: The house stands on four legs.
scenes.visual: A house on four sturdy stilts, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: One: if you pass away while you're still earning, is your family left with something?
scenes.visual: Stilt house, first stilt glowing gold, red heart icon, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Two: if an accident stops you from working, where does your income come from?
scenes.visual: Stilt house, second stilt glowing gold, bandage icon, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Three: if a serious illness stops you from working, where does your income come from?
scenes.visual: Stilt house, third stilt glowing gold, thermometer icon, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Four: whether it's an accident or illness, the hospital bill comes first. Who pays it?
scenes.visual: Stilt house, fourth stilt glowing gold, hospital icon, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: You could save for each one in the bank. But what if you've saved 20,000 and the bill is 50,000?
scenes.visual: Four piggy banks under a stilt house, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Saving on your own is like taking the stairs to the 20th floor. If something happens at the 8th floor, you're stuck there.
scenes.visual: Tall staircase into the clouds, a backpack left on a landing halfway, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Protection is the lift beside the stairs. When you can't climb any further, it takes you straight to the top.
scenes.visual: Glass lift shooting up beside a tall staircase, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Once the legs are strong, then you build the body of the house: long-term savings.
scenes.visual: Stilt house with brick walls being built on top, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Mainly for two things: your kids' education, and your own retirement.
scenes.visual: Graduation cap and rocking chair inside a cosy house, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Why legs first? Because if you save without them, one bad wind can send all your savings straight to the hospital.
scenes.visual: House without stilts falling in the wind, coins pouring toward a hospital, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Only when the legs and the body are solid do you add the roof: investing. Invest before that, and you're gambling with your family's future.
scenes.visual: Roof being lowered onto a finished stilt house, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.voice: Legs. Body. Roof. In that order. Which part of your house is still missing?
scenes.visual: Complete stilt house standing steady in the wind, blue sky, 3D icon style, no people

scenes.text: For general education only. Not financial advice.
scenes.visual: Disclaimer screen with a clean modern background, 3D icon style, no people

caption:
Most people build their finances upside down.
Start with the foundation before you invest.
